summary: Tested AMASS MY HOME and HOME PROTECT, backend and frontend (390x844 plus a layout pass at 360x640). Backend: the existing test_iter105 suite passes 12/12. The new edge-case suite (test_iter106_home_protect_edges.py) passes 13/13: status without home_id, foreign item_ids ignored, renting home gets building=false/0, sequential double pay is idempotent, claim dated before cover starts returns 422, non-admin gets 403, items/overview/spending/notifications integration, and AI identify/receipt return the documented shape. CRITICAL: the concurrent pay race test FAILED. 4 parallel POSTs to /quotes/{id}/pay debited 4x and created 4 policies. Frontend: every requested flow works end to end with no runtime console errors and no nested <button> warnings. Flows covered: dashboard tiles and banner, AI scan with receipt read and save, items list, add-on quote and pay, new policy on Ikeja, claim with photo and reply, the full admin claim lifecycle with the MASS payout credited (+2000), rate card edit and save, new rate card validation, notifications, wallet, calendar and bills. Found 1 critical backend race, 2 backend logic bugs, several UX/design issues and some truncation at 360px. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: Not race-safe. The status=='paid' check is followed by the debit with no atomic claim on the quote. 4 concurrent requests on one quote returned 200 x4, debited 240 MASS instead of 60, and created 4 separate policies. A double tap or network retry on 'Pay' will double charge. Fix: atomically flip the quote with find_one_and_update({id, status:'quoted'} -> {status:'paying'}) before debiting, and return the existing policy or 409 to the losers. Alternatively add a unique index on hp_policies.quote_id. Reference: /app/backend/home_protect.py:478-526

Same check-then-act pattern (read status, then WalletService.credit). Two concurrent 'paid' decisions can credit the payout twice. Use an atomic update conditioned on status != 'paid' before crediting. Found in code review; not exercised by a test. Reference: home_protect.py:758-786

minor.issue: Deleting a home leaves its live hp_policies active (orphaned). They stay in /protect/status (no home filter), admin 'Live policies' and spending. Either block deletion when there is live cover or cancel/flag the policies. Reproduced with a TEST_ home; QA cancelled those test policies manually.

A home with ownership=null is treated as owner, so building cover is included. 'Ikeja rental' has ownership null and was charged ₦15,000 for building cover. Consider asking for ownership first, or defaulting to excluded.

The payout is prefilled from the customer's estimated loss (₦200,000) and the plan excess (₦5,000) is never deducted. The claim screen says 'insurer deducts it from any payout'. There is no cap at the item value or contents limit.
Body text uses raw ISO dates ('runs until 2027-11-09', add-on 'until 2027-11-09'). Other copy uses '9 Nov 2027'.

ui_bugs.issue: Toggle renders only the switch. The `label` prop is only used as accessibilityLabel, so 'Cover the building (fire, flood, storm…)' on the quote screen and 'Live — quote customers from this card' on the rate card editor show as unlabeled switches. Users can't tell what they toggle.

The AI replacement estimate (₦2,350,000) stays as 'Worth now' after the receipt fills Paid = ₦250,000. The item is saved as worth ₦2.35m (9x the price paid) and is then insured and priced on that value (₦47,000 add-on premium). The receipt price should override, or the user should be prompted when the two differ widely.
The 'Not found' line shows raw backend keys ('payment_method, receipt_number').
'Pick the appliance' error shows in red before the user has interacted with the form.

integration_issues.flow: Item detail Protect on a home with live cover
integration_issues.issue: For an unprotected item on Lekki (live Premium), item-protect routes to /home/protect/quote?home_id&item_id in new-policy mode with a 3-step stepper. The user picks a plan, taps 'See my quote', gets 409 already_covered and is bounced to /home/protect. Confusing dead end. When overview/status has a live policy, route to the add-on quote (policy_id=…), as protect-add-{id} already does. Reference: app/home/items/[id].tsx:140

action_items: CRITICAL: make quotes/{id}/pay atomic (conditional find_one_and_update on status 'quoted' before debit, and/or a unique index on hp_policies.quote_id). Re-run tests/test_iter106_pay_race.py.
Make admin decide 'paid' atomic so the payout can't be credited twice.
Item detail item-protect: if the home has a live policy, go to the add-on quote (policy_id) instead of new-policy mode.
Toggle component: render the visible label text (or wrap callers in a labeled row).
Scan: let the receipt price override the AI 'Worth now', or warn when they differ widely.
DELETE home with force: handle live Home Protect policies (block or cancel).
Fix 360px truncation on the protect hero buttons, admin summary tiles and items-summary labels.
Optional: deduct the excess in the payout prefill; format dates in notification bodies; treat ownership=null as unknown for building cover.

rca_of_issue: Double debit: pay_quote reads the quote, checks status=='paid', then debits and inserts the policy, and only marks the quote paid at the end (line 526). Concurrent requests all pass the check before any of them writes. Reproduce: tests/test_iter106_pay_race.py. Mitigation: claim the quote atomically first and roll back on debit failure.
